common_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: individual synthetic test-account portrait, not a collage. Image 1 is the authoritative identity reference of a fictional adult man. Generate a NEW photorealistic photograph of exactly that SAME person: preserve facial geometry, eyes, nose, mouth, ears, jawline, skin tone, age, skin marks, hairline and facial hair. Keep realistic visible pores and natural texture. One person, one clearly visible face, eyes open, no glasses, no hat, no face obstruction, no other people or reflected faces. Upright square 1024 x 1024 photograph, full head and upper chest, face large and in sharp focus, gentle natural lighting, correct anatomy. No captions, text, collage, watermark or logos. Dress him in ordinary casual clothing; no uniforms, badges, work clothing or professional attire.
